title: ClaimKeysV0_1
description: An issuer's published Ed25519 verification keys (the /.well-known/constitutional-cms/keys.json document). The document BINDS the keys to an issuer: a verifier refuses a bundle whose issuer differs from this document's issuer (issuer_mismatch), so possession of a key never lets one party sign in another's name. Two entries sharing a key_id are refused fail-closed. DRAFT until founder ratification.

issuer.description: Registrable domain this document publishes keys FOR. A bundle whose issuer differs is refused.

public_key.description: Base64 of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, canonically padded.
